ruinousPowers.name: The Ruinous Powers
ruinousPowers.description: The forces of Chaos—anarchic, divisive, and powerful. Encourage followers to do what they want without worry for others.

blessedPantheon.name: The Blessed Pantheon
blessedPantheon.description: The force of Law and Order—stabilizing, promoting civilization and community. Tied to the physical realm and opposed to Warp intrusion.

grayCouncil.name: The Gray Council
grayCouncil.description: Neutral gods that don't align with Chaos or Order. Most serve only their own goals and can be found in every corner without facing opposition.

unaligned.name: Unaligned
unaligned.description: Those who refuse to pick sides—atheists, agnostics, or those abandoned by the gods.

alignments.name: Khorne
alignments.description: The god of battle and blood. Loves every type of warfare. Worship is through bloodshed from enemies in victory or your own through earnest struggle.
commandments: Spill blood in his name. It can be your blood or the blood of your enemies, but do not shy from violence.
Do not trust in sorcery, and do not seek to learn its secrets—magic is the way of the weak.
Fight in honorable combat, not against the weak or helpless.
alignments.restriction: Khorne hates magic. If you have Khorne as alignment, some Exalt/racial powers may be unusable. Replace magic school ranks with sword school ranks.

sins.sin: Giving mercy to a fellow warrior.
Allowing another to kill an innocent.
Travelling with a spellcaster.
Showing disrespect for another warrior.
Using stealth or trickery to avoid a fight.
Breaking your word of honor.
Killing an innocent.
Allowing a spell to be cast on you.
Refusing a challenge of combat.
Casting a Spell.

alignments.name: Slaanesh
alignments.description: The god of excess—sex, drugs and rock and roll. About doing what you enjoy without holding back. The drive to be perfect.
commandments: Turn away from no new experience, unless it would kill you—try everything once.
Stand out from those around you. To blend in is to lose who you are.
Tempt others with what you enjoy—share drink, invite them to lavish meals, turn them to hedonism.

sins.sin: Refusing a new, but dangerous, experience.
Accepting a flawed experience.
Doing something you don't enjoy.
Doing less than your best at any task.
Refusing to do something you enjoy.
Denying another a new experience.
Showing humility.
Not attempting to fix or overcome a flaw.
Doing less than your best at an important task.
Refusing a new, safe, experience.

alignments.name: Tzeentch
alignments.description: The god of change and hope. Listens to hopes and plans of every mortal, altering history through complex plots.
commandments: Be flexible with your plans. Always be open to change as needed.
Change what you don't like in yourself. Use sorcery! All the sorcery!
Follow your own goals. Take command of your destiny.

sins.sin: Failing to spend at least two hours per day planning and plotting.
Failing to kill for the sake of knowledge.
Putting another's needs before your plans.
Clinging to the old and refusing to change.
Refusing to take advantage of a situation.
Sharing knowledge with another except as part of a broader plan.
Improvising when there's a chance to make a plan.
Turning down a chance for increased power.
Failing to respect those who possess greater wisdom.
Failing to pursue arcane knowledge.

alignments.name: Nurgle
alignments.description: The god of despair who cares about you and your diseases. A god of life and death—two sides of the same coin.
commandments: Don't bother seeking help. Fail or succeed through your own perseverance.
You can only escape suffering through faith.
Be kind to those facing death. They cannot be saved, but make them comfortable.

sins.sin: Refusing to comfort the sick or the dying.
Preserving anything—food, the environment, etc.
Doing unnecessary work.
Making great shows of emotion, positive or negative.
Attempting to change your own fate.
Being unkind to those in need.
Curing someone of a disease.
Preserving a corpse.
Bringing another back from the dead.
Attempting to change the fate of the Wheel.

alignments.name: Malal
alignments.description: A renegade god—the embodiment of Chaos' indiscriminate destructive urge, even of itself. Hated by other gods.
commandments: Hate gives you strength. Learn to truly hate those that oppose you. No mercy.
Destruction is the fate of all that exists. Destroy all that is.
Betrayal can get you what you want. If people can't defend themselves, that's their problem.

sins.sin: Falling in love.
Acting in the interests of another.
Keeping your word when it would help another.
Asking aid of another.
Needlessly preventing a death.
Exhibiting compassion for others.
Aiding another.
Accepting the superiority of another.
Failing to take advantage of another's weakness.
Repenting one's behavior.

alignments.name: Chaos Undivided
alignments.description: Worship Chaos as a whole instead of any single god. Natural leaders among Chaos forces with a more spiritual view.

sins.sin: Failing to spend at least two hours meditating on the nature of Chaos per day.
Refusing to aid another follower of Chaos.
Refusing to offer a non-Chaos worshipper a chance to convert.
Failing to observe the rituals of Chaos.
Failing to undermine the existing order in favor of Chaos.
Not making the effort to learn more about the nature of Chaos.
Placing one Chaos God above any other.
Showing cowardice.
Showing overt disrespect for the forces of Chaos.
Accepting someone less capable than yourself as your superior.

alignments.name: Tiamat
alignments.description: The diametric opposite to Bahamut. Formed a great alliance to overthrow him. Rumors persist of attempts to revive her.

sins.sin: Failing to pursue evidence of Tiamat, even at risk of death.
Failing to use whatever means are necessary to achieve greater power.
Accepting defeat.
Helping others when it is not to your advantage.
Failing to respect those who possess greater power.
Failing to pursue evidence of Tiamat when there is little risk.
Backing down when you know you are right.
Turning down a chance for increased wealth or power.
Losing face in front of a crowd.
Accepting someone equal or less capable than yourself as your superior.

alignments.name: Sigmar
alignments.description: A wrathful and vengeful god, protector of followers. A warrior king and great unifier. Most commonly worshipped by humans.
commandments: Work with others to achieve your goals. Community and order are stronger than lone individuals.
Tame the wilderness for habitation, defend civilization against encroaching darkness.
Seek out new ideas, inventions, lands. Build machines, cities, empires.

sins.sin: Allowing something to remain wild or untamed.
Travelling with a known worshipper of Chaos.
Refusing to advance a primitive society.
Eating raw food.
Unnecessarily destroying infrastructure or order.
Unknowingly aiding the forces of Chaos.
Showing mercy towards a Chaos-worshipper.
Not spending at least an hour per day among others.
Attempting to destroy a civilization.
Aiding the forces of Chaos, knowingly.

alignments.name: Bahamut
alignments.description: God of nobility and the just use of power. The platinum dragon, worshipped by those in power. Popular among Dragonborn.
commandments: Uphold the highest ideals of honor and justice.
Be constantly vigilant against evil and oppose it on all fronts.
Protect the weak, liberate the oppressed, defend just order.

sins.sin: Not treating your subordinates appropriately.
Not treating your superior with respect.
Refusing to depose an unfit or corrupt ruler.
Assisting unknowingly with the resurrection of Tiamat.
Taking orders from an inferior.
Abusing power for personal gain.
Refusing to take charge when offered the opportunity.
Taking orders from an agent of Chaos.
Breaking your word of honor.
Assisting willingly in the resurrection of Tiamat.

alignments.name: Pelor
alignments.description: God of mercy and kindness. Associated with the sun and bringing light into dark places. Encourages acts of kindness.
commandments: Alleviate suffering wherever you find it.
Bring Pelor's light into places of darkness, showing kindness, mercy, and compassion.
Be watchful against evil.

sins.sin: Failing to treat an enemy with kindness and respect.
Failing to spend at least an hour per day in sunlight when possible.
Refusing to help someone who genuinely needs it, even if there's danger.
Allowing an innocent to become corrupted.
Failing to treat a stranger with kindness and respect.
Failing to do at least one good deed per day.
Refusing to help someone who genuinely needs it, when there's no danger.
Failing to treat a friend with kindness and respect.
Allowing the forces of darkness to harm innocents.
Torture, of anyone, for any reason.

alignments.name: Moradin
alignments.description: Stoic, loyal, big on family and bigger on hard work. A creative god whose followers are encouraged to make lasting marks.
commandments: Meet adversity with stoicism and tenacity.
Demonstrate loyalty to your family, your clan, your leaders, and your people.
Strive to make a lasting legacy. To make something that lasts is the highest good.

sins.sin: Failing to spend at least an hour per day creating something.
Showing great emotions.
Shaving.
Forgiving a slight against you without retribution.
Not drinking at least one tankard of ale per day.
Doing harm to any member of your family.
Allowing feelings to affect your work.
Telling a deliberate lie.
Failing to show respect for your elders and ancestors.
Desecrating the legacy of your ancestors.

alignments.name: Cuthbert
alignments.description: God of eternal bonds and trust. Common superstition holds he will personally curse anyone who breaks a contract made in his name.
commandments: Your word is your bond. Never break it for any reason.
Never allow your fear to gain mastery over you, but drive it into the hearts of your foes.
Repay betrayal with the sword. Trust others until they break that trust.

sins.sin: Breaking the law for any reason.
Travelling with a criminal except to see him brought to justice.
Refusing to punish someone guilty of a major crime.
Not assisting an officer of the law when asked.
Breaking the law to help another.
Failing to pursue evidence of a major crime.
Not showing respect for a legitimate officer of the law.
Refusing to punish someone guilty of a major crime.
Breaking the law for personal gain.
Breaking your word of honor.

alignments.name: Blessed Order
alignments.description: General worship of the Blessed Pantheon. Core belief that everything happens for a reason and only the gods know all.

sins.sin: Failing to meditate on the nature of Order for at least two hours per day.
Failing to make an attempt to convert someone to Order.
Allowing emotions to override logic.
Refusing to mediate in conflicts.
Breaking the law except to help someone in great need.
Unknowingly aiding the forces of Chaos.
Holding any god of Order above another.
Harming another for personal gain.
Breaking your word of Honor.
Knowingly aiding the forces of Chaos.

alignments.name: Omnissiah
alignments.description: God of technology and animistic machine spirits. Seen as a huge Wheel-spanning machine with every worshipper a cog.

sins.sin: Speaking in a language other than Binary.
Destroying any technology.
Showing any emotions.
Failing to try to understand a new technology.
Accidentally damaging ancient or advanced technology.
Failing to show respect to a machine when using it.
Allowing emotions to override logic.
Having bionics replaced with flesh.
Choosing the flesh over the perfection of the machine.
Willfully destroying ancient or advanced technology.

alignments.name: Acererak
alignments.description: God of Magic itself. Legend says he gave away his body piece by piece to learn all secrets, leaving only a skull.
commandments: Seek the perfection of your mind by balancing reason, perception, and emotion.
Accumulate, preserve, and keep secret knowledge in all forms. Seek lost and ancient lore.
Never reveal all that you know.

sins.sin: Revealing your face to anyone.
Failing to pursue new knowledge for at least one hour a day.
Telling another a secret that would harm them.
Telling anyone your true name.
Telling anyone a secret that would not harm you.
Refusing to gain new knowledge when it is offered.
Revealing your alignment.
Not trying to learn someone's secrets.
Telling another a secret that could harm you.
Destroying unique knowledge.

alignments.name: The Raven Queen
alignments.description: Handles things when they die. Pulls souls into the Warp and lets them out when time for rebirth—though she prefers not to let them out.
commandments: Hold no pity for those who suffer and die, for death is the natural end of life.
Bring down the proud who try to cast off fate's chains. Punish hubris where you find it.
Keep to the shadows, avoiding zealous good and utter darkness.

sins.sin: Trying to avoid your own death when it is your time.
Healing anyone's wounds.
Not attempting to destroy an undead creature.
Bringing someone back from the dead.
Killing a carrion-eating animal.
Unnecessary desecration of a corpse.
Killing someone before their time.
Saving someone when it is their time.
Not treating the dead with respect.
Creating an undead creature.

alignments.name: Luna
alignments.description: Fickle and everchanging. Commands people to follow their own paths and not let others rule them.
commandments: Change is inevitable, but ensure it is for the better through faithful work.
Strike back against those who would rob you of freedom and urge others to fight for liberty.
Do not fear or condemn nature's savagery. Live in harmony with the wild.

sins.sin: Eating anything you didn't personally kill.
Shaving.
Destroying trees or wilderness for no reason.
Killing a wild animal for no reason.
Going a full month without attending a ceremony devoted to Luna.
Refusing to change when it is needed.
Killing a werewolf except in self defense or as part of a hunt.
Trying to break a wild animal.
Failing to respect nature.
Spending a full month without going into the wild, except if restrained.

alignments.name: Corellon
alignments.description: God of excellence and one of the very few living Eldarin gods. Cannot abide failure but reminds followers they haven't failed until they refuse to try again.
commandments: Cultivate beauty in all you do, whether casting spells, composing sagas, or practicing war.
Seek out lost magic items, forgotten rituals, and ancient works of art.
Show neither pity nor mercy to those caught underfoot as you climb to power.

sins.sin: Not showing off with every action when people are watching.
Not making a challenge to someone boasting of their skill.
Eating meat from an animal you didn't personally kill.
Refusing a challenge of any kind.
Showing humility except to a superior.
Destroying trees or wilderness for no reason.
Not shaving.
Refusing a challenge in something you're skilled at.
Not respecting Elven culture.
Failing at any task when you have put your reputation on the line.

alignments.name: Vectron
alignments.description: Undoubtedly the greatest of all gods, with all of the powers. Accepts worship from anyone for any reason in any way.
commandments: Do not question the validity of Vectron as a god. He's the biggest, best god.
There is no problem that cannot be solved by praising Vectron loudly enough.
Make sure to let people know Vectron helped you. Try to convert others.

sins.sin: Failing to praise Vectron by name in every conversation.
Not carrying a book of Vectron's teachings.
Denying the credibility of any miracle attributed to Vectron.
Attempting to discredit anyone acting as a prophet of Vectron.
Failing to praise Vectron by name once an hour, except when sleeping.
Failing to prominently display one of Vectron's holy symbols.
Making war on other followers of Vectron.
Failing to praise Vectron by name once a day.
Not adding to the scriptures of Vectron with your deeds.
Not accepting Vectron as your ultimate lord and savior.

alignments.name: Lolth
alignments.description: God of the Dark Eldarin. A daemon of extraordinary power who achieved godhood by protecting them. Stands alone, not aligned with Order or Chaos.

sins.sin: Refusing to cause harm to a friend when it would benefit you.
Showing mercy to an enemy.
Failing to make a sacrifice to Lolth at least once a month.
Refusing to kill when it would benefit you.
Showing respect to a male.
Showing fear in front of an inferior.
Refusing an opportunity to harm an enemy.
Wearing concealing clothing except in extreme weather.
Not showing respect to a female.
Killing a spider of any kind.

alignments.name: Unaligned
alignments.description: Those who refuse to pick sides—don't believe gods are worthy of worship, were abandoned, or think gods don't exist.

sins.sin: Showing respect for the worship of any god.
Failing to help someone who is in genuine need.
Not making an attempt to convert someone to atheism.
Taking orders from a religious authority.
Hurting someone for no reason.
Discriminating for or against someone based on their religion.
Pretending to be a religious person.
Killing for no reason.
Participating in a religious ceremony.
Prayer.

devotionMechanics.alignmentCheck: Roll 1d10. If you match or exceed your Devotion, pass. If you fail, permanently lose 1 Devotion.
devotionMechanics.degeneration: When losing Devotion to 6 or less, make a second alignment test. Failure causes Degeneration (roll on Degeneration Chart).
devotionMechanics.zeroDevotionEffect: Character is immediately removed from play—killed, driven insane, or mutated into a chimeric horror.
devotionMechanics.raising: Can increase Devotion by spending XP, maximum one point at a time. Must demonstrate contrition.

changingAlignment.differentPantheon: Set to Devotion 4, roll on Degeneration Chart for affliction at Devotion 7.
